item.title: Trump family curse continues as Trump boys develop bone spurs in anticipation of war with Iran
item.description: After the US attacked Iran, the military-age sons of President Trump are understood to have simultaneously developed bone spurs - which would exempt them from any draft, were one introduced.

item.title: If this doesn’t take their minds off Epstein, nothing will, insists Trump
item.description: Beautiful footage of rapidly expanding clouds of smoke and burning infrastructure had better take people’s minds off Epstein, President Trump has told supporters this morning.

item.title: Donald Trump’s biggest critic now his own 2013 Twitter account
item.description: Donald Trump’s 2013 Twitter account has launched a stinging attack on 2026 Donald Trump for attacking Iran while his polling numbers are so bad.

item.title: Donald Trump awarded FIFA War Prize
item.description: President Trump has been awarded the FIFA War Prize this morning.

item.title: Furious holidaymakers forced to crop debris out of Dubai selfies
item.description: Holidaymakers in Dubai are absolutely furious today after the US-Israeli conflict with Iran meant they had to crop debris out of their pristine selfies.

item.title: ‘If Donald Trump jumped off a cliff, would you do it too?’ asks Keir Starmer’s mum
item.description: Keir Starmer got a massive bollocking from his mum today after fresh fears the UK could join the US-Israeli conflict with Iran.

item.title: Donald Trump to stop bombing Iran and claim he ended his ninth war
item.description: In a stroke of genius, US President Donald Trump admitted he is planning to stop bombing Iran and then immediately claim credit for ending his ninth war.

item.title: Man ‘pimping up’ meals actually just adding chilli flakes
item.description: A man who claims he is using transformational 'food hacks' to pimp up all of his meals is actually just modifying a standard recipe in a really small and boring way, it has been revealed.

item.title: Rachel Reeves spotted checking down the back of every government sofa ahead of Spring Statement
item.description: With minutes days to go before delivering her Spring Statement, Chancellor Rachel Reeves has reportedly been spotted rummaging behind every government sofa in a desperate hunt for spare change, long-forgotten valuables, or perhaps a magic cheque marked “From Gordon Brown — for emergencies.”

item.title: Pete Hegseth apologises for love-bite on Donald Trump’s neck
item.description: Despite the White House claiming a rash on Donald Trump’s neck was caused by a ‘preventative skin treatment’, it has now been revealed the red mark is actually a love-bite from Secretary of War Pete Hegseth.
